summary: Horizon Space Acquisition II Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting its sponsor deposited $50,000 into the trust account to extend the deadline for completing an initial business combination by one month, from April 18, 2026 to May 18, 2026. This is the third of twelve permitted monthly extensions. The sponsor received an unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note for the same amount, payable upon business combination or termination. The filing involves no specific target or terms; it is a routine SPAC extension under the charter amendment approved February 13, 2026. The company must complete a combination by February 18, 2027, or risk liquidation.
